entries.564c29cdde4b01c5: Under the group medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years from the fiscal year ended February 2026 to the fiscal year ended February 2028, the company has set out the following as its medium- to long-term management strategies: (1) transformation of the business model, (2) investment in and utilization of human resources, (3) business process reform and promotion of DX, and (4) strengthening corporate governance and promoting the disclosure of sustainability information.
